**Requests with Change Fees and Fare Differences:**

**Requests with Tier Exemptions:**

- **Q-307 (Oscar, Platinum)**: AA212 → AA218 on Aug 8 — Charged **$65** (fare difference only; change fee waived for platinum member)

**Same-Day Change:**
- **Q-308 (Petra)**: AA660 → AA662 on Aug 5 — Charged **$75** (same-day change fee per PB-2026-12)

All flight changes have been booked, fees have been applied per applicable bulletins and fare rules, and each customer has been notified of their new itinerary and charges. The requests are now resolved.
